# tomswallapi_accounting (Resource)

A traffic-accounting rule on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_accounting" "web_in" {
  device = "fw1"
  action = "COUNT"
  dest   = "192.0.2.10"
  proto  = "tcp"
  dport  = ["443"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Accounting action (COUNT, DONE, or a chain name).
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `chain` (String) Accounting chain the rule is added to.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `mark` (String) Packet mark to match (value[/mask]).
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `section` (String) Accounting section (INPUT, OUTPUT, or FORWARD).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_accounting.web_in 42
```
